category: cloud torrent seedbox with cloud-host import (hosted)

free_tier.stated: No free allowance stated; account creation is advertised as free ('Create an account It's Free!') and the plans start at a 3-day trial for $1.00.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-file cap stated; storage is 20 GB on the 3-day trial and 100 GB on the 30-day and longer plans

retention.stated: Seedbox keeps a torrent until a 1:10 ratio or 10 days.

egress.terms: Unlimited downloads and gigabit speeds are stated for every plan; no volume cap stated.

interface_detail: WebDAV access, remote downloader, remote file uploader, FTP and cloud-host connectors (Dropbox, Box, Mega, pCloud, 1fichier, Google Drive, OneDrive) are listed.

limits.value: private cloud storage 20 GB on the 3-day trial, 100 GB (plus extra) on longer plans

binding_note: Storage size is the only metered figure stated; downloads are stated as unlimited.

identity_cost.detail: Registration page: the new account password is sent to the email address entered; Google sign-in is offered.

reliability_note: No outage observed on the day read.
confidence_note: First-party home page and registration page.

evidence.proved: the cheapest plan is $1.00 for 3 days

evidence.quote: - 100GB NVMe SSD Powered Private Cloud Storage
evidence.proved: longer plans carry 100 GB of storage

evidence.quote: - Seedbox (seed torrent until 1:10 ratio or 10 days)
evidence.proved: seeding runs to a 1:10 ratio or 10 days
